name: Freebooter Keep
title: Freebooter Keep
summary: A stronghold on Freebooter Isle with the Black Market inside, a society fort with a Crystal Array platform (acpedia). In the kit, a walled castle stands on a sheer mesa top at z 148 above the sea. It has a six-storey red-roofed spire keep (top z 179.5), spire towers, stone wings, golden bamboo gates, society banners and a 25 m tower on the east cliff edge with a glowing purple sphere. A 90 m cliff drops into a ravine on the east, and blue paper lanterns light a stair down the north ridge.

landmarks.name: East cliff
landmarks.note: 90 m drop to a ravine at z 50, the sea beyond.

site.name: Freebooter Keep
site.notes: Every gazetteer teleport for Freebooter Keep (freebooter-keep and the Black Market entries) is indoor; derived @teleloc on the open mesa top 41 m north-east of the keep's spire, outside the golden bamboo gates (ground z 148.0, nearest object 22 m).

shots.standingOrder: Arc clockwise 140 m out over the eastern sea cliffs and 30 m above the mesa top, holding Freebooter Keep's red spire on its sheer rock with the morning sun behind the lens; never below 15 m over the rocks.
